FIG. 01 — WEBCAM → 3D PATIENT MODEL

01
OVERVIEW
STACK
Python
FastAPI
Computer Vision
Swift
Physical therapy only works if the exercises are done right — and most of them happen at home, alone, with no one watching your form.
Mira is an at-home physical therapy coach. A regular webcam captures the patient, a live 3D model mirrors their movement in real time, and an AI coach corrects form between clinic visits. If the patient falls, Mira raises an alert. It took 1st Overall at CodeRED Orion.
02
WHAT I BUILT
4 SYSTEMS
01
Webcam → live 3D patient model
Pose landmarks from a single, ordinary webcam drive a live 3D model of the patient — no sensors, no special hardware.
02
Real-time pose streaming
A FastAPI backend streams joint data continuously, so feedback lands mid-rep instead of after the session.
03
Fall alerts
Sudden posture changes are flagged the moment they happen, so a caregiver knows when something goes wrong.
04
AI coaching
Form corrections and encouragement generated from the patient’s own movement, delivered on web and iOS.
RESULT
1st Overall — CodeRED Orion.
